translations./garage/brief: Take a tracked chassis over the same sandy route. Sand consumes traction, while skid steering consumes more traction to turn; both effects arrive together.

translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Gentle control can finish sooner by avoiding large localization errors. Compare elapsed time.
